lines.en: I knock on Tsuneyo’s door and wait for her to-
: Begone, creature of the night! Take those blasted raps upon my chamber door and spend them elsewhere! Perhaps even Elsweyr! This party has already reached maximum capacity!
Was that directed at me?
I knock again just to be sure.
: I said begone! And know that I am using thaumaturgy this time, so my voice is three times louder! This motley crew of wanton adventurers needs not your wares, merchant of lust!
: Is Tsuneyo in there? Can you get her for me?
: I knoweth not this name you speak! So I suggest you depart at once and return to your incessant pursuit of taking inventory on the souls you have claimed! Thine bedpost is notched enough, intruder!
Yeah, I don’t have the energy to deal with this tonight.
: Okay. Goodnight, Molly. See you tomorrow, probably.
: Anime doesn’t exist in real life which means NO night is good! Now fare thee well, incubus!
: Okay. That should do it. I’ve sufficiently annoyed him enough to buy us at least twenty-four hours.
: That seems like more time than we will need. But I still applaud your ability to abstain from sex on my behalf, Emerald Guardian.
: Thanks. I’ve been practicing my whole life. And it isn’t often that you reach out for assistance in areas in which I am an expert, Kendo Princess.
: What’s one more night without a penis inside of me when I have already spent so many? Now, tell me — what is thine pleasure? Thou greatest, most tempestuous desire? Speak it and you shall receive.
: I’d like to learn more about consensual sex in the missionary position.

: Damn it, Tsuneyo! You aren’t ready for that yet! You can’t just make an account and wander straight into Kel Thuzad’s lair! You must first obtain a reason to visit Naxxramas at all or you won’t know the point!
: I apologize. Please show me the single most depraved sexual scenario you have stored on your personal computer. I understand that I must now work backwards.
: How about this one? This was one of my firsts.
: Yes. I can already feel the arousal beginning.
: This is just the main menu.
: It has completely consumed me. I must fuck immediately.
: Tsuneyo, be serious! One can learn all there is to know about sexuality through eroge! And if you truly intend to study such content, you must approach it with an open mind and a desire to learn!
: I apologize. I am ready to hear why you think this intellectual property will make me both vaginally damp and more determined to fuck.
: The story of Shuffle begins when the realms of both demons and gods open up and flood humanity as we know it with their presence!
: Now, I’m no graphic designer, but I do not think this menu screen displays even a hint of that.
: It’s lighthearted, mostly. The anime takes a weird turn near the end but, basically, a demon girl and god girl wind up moving next door to the protagonist and they’re each determined to marry him.
: Generic slop. Next.

: It’s actually quite more than that! The merging of different species and races creates a centralized theme about multiculturalism and the importance of communal integration that we, as outsiders, can relate to!
: Nonsense. I am only half-outsider. Such themes mean nothing to me. Describe the sex.
: Good. Normal, mostly. Though, there is one scene where the protagonist has his mind slowly wiped while penetrating the smart and despondent loli character. That one was good.
: Perhaps something else. I do not think this is the title that will unlock my sexuality, Emerald Guardian.
: Hmm...well, what do you think would? Something...more emotional? More...chaotic? Give me something to work with!
: Perhaps emotional. But also chaotic. With lots of sexual content. Good sexual content. Both morally good and morally bad. With an emotionally distant protagonist.
: Uhhhh...okay. Okay.
: How about this one?
: This is a sequel, Guardian.
: Not really. It’s more just that this game occurs after the events of the first game.
: I am surprised to learn that, despite your apparent experience, you still do not understand the meaning of the word “sequel.”
: Okay, okay. Fine. Emotional. Chaotic. Sex. Uhh...oh!
: Cross Channel! It’s got all of that stuff! Though, I’d say the protagonist is less emotionally distant and more...um...emotionally...broken? Traumatically perverted? Does that make sense?
: Perhaps in context. What is this one about?

: A bunch of students get thrown into a time loop where their minds are periodically reset! Told with sporadic, flowery, almost maniacal prose and backed by a narrative that gets more convoluted the deeper you go!
: Sexual abuse. Manipulation. Trauma. The flaws of humanity! The exploration of youth! The ingrained desire to connect despite not understanding how to do so and-
: Boring. Just show me something with a lot of naked women and an even larger variety of naked men that insert things into them.
: Sure. Here’s Dohna Dohna.
: My interest has been piqued. I would look breedable in all of those outfits.
: Yeah, well, you look breedable in everything as you were sculpted by the gods themselves.
: Will this title arouse me? Or will it turn me into the same type of pervert you have become after consuming such overtly lewd content on a nightly basis?
: Both probably. Plus, this game has an entire brothel management simulator and a dungeon crawling combat system. Probably not for you if you enjoy the concept of consent, though.
: I have no idea what I enjoy.

: Perhaps I am the type of dime-store slut who wishes to be used by strangers. Or a lustrous dominatrix who ties up and murders her victims, keeping their organs like sexual trophies in her nightstand.
: Just buy sex toys. They don’t really “go bad” so long as you’re properly maintaining them. And I’m pretty sure organs would.
: If I play this non-consensual brothel game, will I acquire the skills I need to impress someone sexually?
: Nope. But it’ll make you think it did and you can always just pretend to be experienced on the Internet.
: If you want to go that route, though, just play Nekopara.
: Nekopara?

: Yeah, everybody’s played Nekopara. And nobody’s going to know what you’re talking about if you bring up Dohna Dohna during a totally normal conversation on Discord about sex in games versus sex in reality.
: So the two are different. That is good to know. Which one is better?
: You’re asking a question that is literally impossible to answer, Kendo Princess. I could master both and still not know.
: Show me this “Nekopara.” I must see with my own eyes what the masses enjoy so I can relate to them on a more sexual level. Which is a thing I want to do.
: We’ll just jump straight to volume two then since that’s the one where we get to have sex with Coconut.
: What is this? There was no story at all. You clicked on one button and now there is a penis inside of that girl. This is terrible writing. It only makes sense that this is what the masses enjoy.
: I just went to the scene gallery. You can’t have an eroge without easy access to all of the sex. A person can only have so many save files.
: So these girls are pretending to be cats?
: No, they are cats. That’s just what cats look like in that world.
: This will be a much sadder game once they are slightly older and need to be euthanized.
: Forget about that part for now!

: Just look at Coconut and try to self-insert! Your proportions aren’t that far off from hers. The personalities don’t really match but, like, sexual personalities and regular personalities don’t always overlap either!
: Ahh, yes. I was wondering why I found her so attractive. I had just assumed it was because of the penis inside of her and not because she reminds me of myself.
: Yeah, my life would be a lot more tense if you were attracted to girls. I’m kind of glad you’re not, honestly.
: Why is she calling him “Master?”
: Chocola’s calling him that. And it’s because they’re having sex with the man who adopted them and forced them into what is essentially slave labor.
: This is a conceptually rotten game. We arrest people for having sex with animals in real life and this man can just get away with it? You were right. Normies really are the worst.

: Yes, but fiction is the perfect outlet to explore things that would be otherwise unthinkable in reality! It’s what keeps people like me coming back to it even now that I know what a real penis feels like!
: The important thing to remember is that just because you’re consuming content like this doesn’t mean it’s indicative of who you are as a person.
: So even if you do find a game you like, it doesn’t mean you’ll actually enjoy the real thing in practice.
: Like, I kind of enjoyed Maggot Baits on a technical and...shameful level. But that doesn’t mean I’d enjoy it if somebody locked me in a superheated torture coffin and burned me alive. Come on.

: I see. And if this is coming from someone as consumed by delusions of grandeur as you, I can only imagine the amount of people incapable of differentiating fiction from reality is very small in number.
: Yeah, you’d think.
: I have decided I will play this “Nekopara.” I see it as my personal duty to liberate Coconut and prevent her master from taking further advantage of her.
: Even if it does seem like she is very much enjoying herself right now.
: Oh, yeah. She loves it. They all do. Probably the most consensual slavery we’ve ever had in a game.
: Does it really feel that good? Or is this but one more example of fiction exaggerating aspects of reality in the name of fourth-wall breaking orgasm extraction?

: A little of both, honestly. Expressions like that are grounded in reality for sure. A lot of it just comes down to finding someone capable of making you feel that way since I imagine not everyone can.
: So you feel that way when Sensei takes advantage of you?
: He doesn’t-
: I have had enough of the Nekopara. I can not focus on liberation with Coconut’s audible ecstasy so ruthlessly assaulting my ears. I will reconvene with her at a later date and time.

: Sure. But just so we’re on the same page here — Sensei isn’t taking advantage of me, Kendo Princess. We’re both fully aware of what our relationship is. I don’t love him, nor do I think he loves me.
: So if you really think you’re ready to do what most of the class has been doing for a while now, I’ll support you. This harem is still manageable as-is.
: I am glad to hear that I have your support. And also that you do not love him, as it would be very easy for me to steal your man if you did.
: If anything, I’m just surprised to hear you even want to do this. I didn’t think you and Sir were anywhere close to that level yet.

: Neither did I until an apparition had her way with me. Now, the pleasures of the flesh run wildly through my mind like a shaka of quokkas outrunning a vicious predator they all just lobbed their children at.
: A shaka?
: It’s what a group of quokkas is called.
: Why do you know that?
: Obviously because my love for quokkas has been an undeniable aspect of my character for as long as we have known each other.
: I’m pretty sure this is the first time you have ever mentioned them.

: Lies. I have always been this way. Everyone knows I am synonymous with love for the quokka. It’s the sole pillar holding who I am as a person up so that I may continue to tower over everyone. Shaka-shaka-hey.
: What’s the plan now, then? Do you even have a plan? Or do you want to do more research first?
: Because I don’t mind finding all these games for you if that’s what you want. Rin and I actually used to play them together all the time until my attraction to her completely overpowered me.
: If the two of us play these games together, will your attraction to me completely overpower you the same way?
: I hope not. That would make it a pattern and I’d be forced to accept that the problem is just me as a whole.

: I appreciate you sharing all of your pornography with me. But I now feel as if this is a road I must walk alone. And that having you so close by while I am trying to liberate Coconut would not help the cause.

: It is for that same reason that I will abstain from sharing any “plan” I may currently have. I would like my first sexual encounter to be natural and unplanned, not something rehearsed and reviewed by peers.
: It was more just me wondering what’s next for you since this is a big change in your life, Kendo Princess. If I had known you were this interested in sex, I’d have lent you a hand sooner.
: Thank you for the offer, but I already have my own and have figured out more or less what needs to be done in order for me to reach climax with it.
: That’s...not what I-
: May I ask you something, Molly?
: Well, I can’t really refuse when you use my real name.
: Do you regret anything?
: Anything, like...like sexually, you mean? About my relationship with the Supreme Overlord?
: It seems as if your outlook on this topic does not match that of everyone else.
: They all speak of love...and jealousy over others seeking the same things as them. But you will allow me to follow you without question.
: Why?
: Uhh...I...I don’t know. I just kind of...do.
: So you care not for romance in any capacity?
: It’s not that. I think it would be nice if Sir was my boyfriend. I just don’t think that’s the situation we’re in and that wanting or expecting that wouldn’t make any sense.
: That’s why it was different with Rin. I wanted to actually date her...be together as a couple...all of that stuff.
: But now, you don’t. And you are content with just having someone to share a bed with. Correct?
: Or a wall. A counter. Whatever’s there, really.
: Interesting.
: I wonder if it still works that way?
: If what works that way?
: If your route counts at all.
: If you’re the type of character who will fade out of the main menu once that route is completed, or if you’re the type to not appear on such a thing in the first place.
: Is it normal to see relationships like that in games? To have a heroine without an ending? Just one there to pad the numbers in the h-scene gallery?
: This conversation is starting to remind me of Totono and now I am sad.
: I don’t know what that is.
: Tsuneyo, the reason heroines like me don’t typically exist inside of visual novels is that I’m just not the type of fantasy people are really looking for.
: What they want is someone like Ami. Fetishy..over-exaggerated...loyal to one person and just crazy enough to keep the story interesting. That’s the type of character I like to read and pursue.
: Nobody wants to read about some girl who just sleeps with her teacher because she likes it and doesn’t really think anything will ever come of it. But that happens in real life all the time.
: Then what does that make us? Assuming I feel the same as you. Consumers?
: Do you and I not fit within the real “story” of the Supreme Overlord? Are we just side characters who’d make no appearance in these “true routes” I’ve heard you mention in the past?
: The way we are now...probably not. No.
: We might get endings, but that’s it. Something would need to change for us to get anything more, I think.
: Could you fall in love with him if it meant extending your time here?
: Like...if the world was a game? And I could keep playing so long as I did that?
: I suppose that is the question I am really asking, yes.
: Could you change yourself if you had to? To survive.
: Or would you die? Alone in a quiet room. Surrounded by wires and styrofoam cups, decorated with rehydrated produce and brown-tinted oil.
: Would you be like Him?
: Are you like Him?
: Is that why we are here together?
: Is that why we suffer?
Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!
